knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Proved all sorries (1→0). Key insight: splitting at ANY T-increase step gives both subproblems with strictly smaller T-difference, enabling clean strong induction without needing to find the 'last' increase.
insights: Key proof technique: strong induction on T_b - T_a (max visit count difference)
Splitting at ANY T-increase step c gives BOTH subproblems with smaller d: left has T_c-T_a < d because T_c < T_{c+1} <= T_b, right has T_b-T_{c+1} < d because T_a <= T_c < T_{c+1}
Simple induction on b-a FAILS for constant-T case: new points can enter F at each constant step (up to 1 per step)
The correct constant for erdos1166_from_ingredients is 3*C+1 with threshold max(N1, N2, ceil(exp(N1+4))+1)
